home.title: Where events meet their sponsors
home.subtitle: Event organizers list sponsorship packages. Hospitals, banks, universities and brands find the right audience and sponsor with confidence. We handle the invoice, the payment and the proof.
home.foundingBanner: Founding Partner offer: organizers pay 0% commission on their first deal.
home.org1: List your event and sponsorship packages for free.
home.org2: We review and publish it to sponsors across the UAE.
home.org3: Receive proposals, chat, and accept the best offer.
home.org4: Deliver the benefits, upload proof, and get paid.
home.sp1: Search events by emirate, audience, date and budget.
home.sp2: Send a proposal for a package, or offer in-kind support.
home.sp3: Pay one invoice from us once the organizer accepts.
home.sp4: Get photo and video proof that your brand was shown.
home.why1: Every organizer and event is checked before it goes live.
home.why2: Your money is released to the organizer only after proof of delivery.
home.why3: Clear invoices for your finance team, in English and Arabic.

payouts.subtitle: Get paid directly to your bank account when a sponsorship is complete.
